resources.string: Mirror folders of this phone into your encrypted orOS Vault. They appear in orOS under Files › orOS Drive › %1$s, and changes go both ways.
Sign in to the Dropbox account orOS syncs with. Dropbox only ever sees encrypted data.
Finish the sign-in in the browser, then come back here.
Type your orOS sync passphrase (Settings › Sync in orOS). It opens the vault key, which this phone keeps in its secure key store; the passphrase itself is not stored.
The vault in the cloud was reset or rebuilt. Type the orOS sync passphrase again.
This passphrase does not open the vault.
There is no orOS vault in this cloud yet. Start one with this passphrase? Use the same passphrase in orOS.
Added. The first sync only adds files; nothing is deleted on either side.
The folder cannot be opened (removed, or its permission was taken back). Nothing is changed.
The vault in the cloud is empty although this folder was synced. Nothing was deleted here.
%1$d files were deleted at once. Delete them in orOS too?
%1$d files are bigger than the limit and stay only on this phone
%1$d files were skipped (names or files orOS cannot take)
Stop mirroring this folder? Files stay on the phone and in orOS.
Sign out? Mirroring stops. Files stay where they are.
Files removed here because they were deleted in orOS are kept for 30 days in Android/data/online.useoros.drive/files/Trash.

The whole orOS disk appears as «orOS» in the Files app and in every app that opens or saves files. A file downloads when you open it and uploads when the app saves it. If it was changed in orOS meanwhile, both versions are kept.
%1$s could not be saved to orOS (%2$s). Save it again from the app you used.
Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology, QNAP or any WebDAV folder: the one orOS syncs with (Settings › Sync › WebDAV in orOS).
App password (made for orOS Drive, not your main password)
No app on this phone opens this kind of file.
Nothing is kept offline yet. Press and hold a file or folder to keep it on this phone.
%1$s is kept offline. It downloads in the background and stays up to date.
This is kept offline with its folder. To stop that, remove the folder in Offline.
Kept on this phone and updated when it changes elsewhere. Tap to open, press and hold to remove.
Use the full https:// address of your server, with no password in it.
Fill in the user name and the app password.
The server did not answer. Check the address and the connection.
The server refused this user name or password.
This address is not a WebDAV folder.
orOS Drive cannot write to this folder on the server.
The server does not report file versions (ETag), so it cannot sync safely.
This server does not stop two devices from overwriting each other (If-Match), so orOS Drive will not sync through it.
Sign out of the current cloud first.
This address is not a Nextcloud server.
The sign-in was not approved in time. Try again.
There is nothing here to send to orOS.
Open orOS Drive, sign in and unlock it first, then share again.

Back up new photos and videos from the camera
New photos and videos go to orOS › Drive › this phone › Camera backup. Only uploads: nothing on the phone is deleted. Videos over 200 MB are left out.
Camera backup needs access to photos and videos.
